actual_summary.scope: Passive complete saved-file joins and literal wire display decoding, not scientific Source execution or mathematical replay.

assessment: We now have an actual automated recipient proof, discovered by the conventional symbolic control in 14 extensions. The complete certificate is linked to its two selected point placements per row and rendered as formulas and English.

This result does not show GCTS doing proof discovery: all six point calls reached their initial decision and then exhausted the cooperative budget inside the first domain audit, before a placement. Their zero attempt count comes from the explicit cutoff record; the missing Counter key alone would not establish zero.

P10 returned 12 initial marking-conflict witnesses per case from a post-cutoff scan. This is evidence of certified initial exclusion conditions, not an independently audited before/after graph-domain delta. No placement, forced propagation or proof discovery followed, so no search-speed benefit is established.

The equality target and missing-premise control reached the symbolic 600-extension budget without a proof. Those search results are unknown. The separate manually supplied singleton countermodel refutes the missing-premise entailment and was never supplied to the search.

The per-arm prerequisite change let unrelated controls run without weakening any proof gate. All cluster-arm omissions are explicit and unavailable, rather than measured zeros. The six-method comparison and cluster-reuse question remain incomplete.

Setup still dominates the full pipeline. The next technical problem is to make complete incidence verification and updates practical without deleting completeness checks or moving uncharged work outside the comparison. Any changed audit/search budget semantics requires a separately declared experiment.

These are three authored development cases, not a blind ATP benchmark or a comparison with the strongest existing provers. No trained RL policy, universal physical Wang qualification, practical plane tiling, arithmetic/Hilbert-geometry completion or whole-program success follows.

cost_notes: S0 found its 14-line certificate in 0.105311 s with 14 primitive row extensions. Full arm including Host, point-region and Native validation: 4.860065 s; this excludes shared cold setup.

Cold donor discovery, validation and mining: 9.421658 s. Full shared recipient setup: 97.504723 s. Compilation/model/reference: 86.190941 s; encoding/check: 4.092583 s; marking/check: 0.009287 s; cluster specialization/admission: 7.150137 s. These containing and nested clocks must not be added as disjoint costs.

The unchanged ground-library query consumed 1,000,000,000 Native microsteps and 7.133564 s for 7 proposed instances, returning unknown. It remains charged, even though only the three primitive arms subsequently ran.
The independent observer completed in 121.868169 s with conservative whole peak 775,700,480 bytes. This includes the actual searches, outputs and custody; it is not the theorem search-only latency.

Point search durations include Graph construction, snapshots, the incomplete first audit and the post-cutoff initial-marking scan. No substage time attribution was measured. The cooperative two-second deadline can overshoot between checkpoints.

The symbolic control shares full point-model setup for this matched experiment. A conventional prover need not incur that overhead. For per-method cold allocation, S0 needs no donor library or additional marking work; P10 adds its marking construction/check. Report acquisition and shared reporting costs separately; no speedup or complete six-method comparison is claimed.
The raw grounding-work counter is 20,003 against a cooperative 20,000 threshold because recursive stop checks increment while unwinding; no unification is performed after the threshold.
cases.failure: The complete six-arm comparison remains incomplete: cluster admission was unknown. No unsuccessful bounded search establishes theorem falsity.
marking_notes: P10 returned 12 initial auxiliary conflict/exclusion witnesses per case; P00 returned 0. The full witness scan runs after the local cutoff against initial alignments. Ordinary Graph construction uses the same marking legality, but no complete recipient graph audit returned. All 36 certificates concern the first-row guard.

Every point arm stopped inside its first complete-domain audit before any placement. No completed recipient domain audit, forced propagation, reduced branching or useful proof-search acceleration was observed.
The unchanged tiny mechanism tests and all 28 compact-reference controls returned in every job. They do not replace the incomplete recipient audits.
